_comment: Template for the ONE-OFF migrations task. Fill the <PLACEHOLDERS> from your AWS account, then `aws ecs register-task-definition --cli-input-json file://this-file.json`. Re-register on every Prisma migration commit so the image tag tracks the latest. NOT a service — invoked via `aws ecs run-task` from the deploy pipeline (see .github/workflows/deploy.example.yml). Logs land in their own CloudWatch group so a failed migration is easy to spot independently of the app.
